text:
emma: Vanguard is seeing p99 timeouts on their Dedicated pool after the 03:00 UTC rollout. CS got API error samples and SLO alerts. Need owners + immediate plan.
raj: checking... paste a sample trace id?
emma: trace id they provided: `req-0a9f3b2c`. p99 for gen endpoints spiked from ~200ms to ~2.1s.
sasha: oncall here. grafana shows queue growth on pool-vanguard-1. autoscaler logs show rate-limit on scale_controller.
olivia: Vanguard is committed Dedicated — CS flagged this as P1. customer wants ETA + workaround.
derek: marking as P1 SLA impact. they're high QPS small prompts. short-term fallback options: hosted routing or lower-cost model variant.
raj: suspect root cause: kernel bump (libcuda 520.x) + new batching heuristic changed capacity math. I pushed a canary to scale-controller earlier in the day. PR #3421 modified autoscale backoff.
emma: can we rollback the controller canary now?
raj: rollback touches batch calc; safer to hotpatch config: increase POOL_MAX to force extra nodes. command I tested:

kubectl -n infra patch deploy scale-controller \
  --type='json' -p='[{"op":"add","path":"/spec/template/spec/containers/0/env/-","value":{"name":"POOL_MAX","value":"120"}}]'

sasha: I can apply that. leader re-election ~2m. low customer impact.
olivia: deploy-bot, recommendation: rollback or config hotpatch?
deploy-bot: Canary r2024.03.10-7 introduced autoscale heuristic changes. Rollback to r2024.03.10-5 is available. Hotpatch recommended for urgent customer-facing regressions.
raj: agree with hotpatch + plan to revert PR #3421 in next window.
emma: ok sasha, run the hotpatch and paste output here.
sasha: applied patch. leader re-elected in 12s. observed provisioning for pool-vanguard-1.
raj: monitoring: queuing dropped within 1m. first sample p99 ~340ms now — still above baseline but within Vanguard's SLA short-term.
derek: I'm telling the customer we hotpatched and are watching. offering hosted fallback if they see recurrence.
emma: assign follow-ups: (1) revert PR #3421 (owner), (2) postmortem doc, (3) rollback runbook if hotpatch fails.
raj: I'll own (1) revert + tests. will open revert PR and run staging integration.
sasha: I'll own (3) rollback runbook and be ready to execute in 30m.
olivia: I'll own (2) customer comms and postmortem stub; I'll tag eng and cs. adding postmortem id vanguard-dedicated-1710123456.
derek: CS: confirm whether customer wants immediate hosted fallback — if yes, route change (raj) + auth keys (security) needed.
raj: router rule change is quick (5-10m) if requested.
emma: saving incident as INC-1710. please paste PR/commit ids and hotpatch outputs here for audit before 04:00 UTC.
raj: will paste revert PR id + test logs.
sasha: will link runbook.
olivia: will link postmortem stub.
derek: customer prefers hosted fallback only if perf regresses. holding off.
deploy-bot: Incident INC-1710 created, severity P1, assigned eng-platform.
emma: thanks :thumbsup:
